title: Construction of a nano-rectangular Zn-Nd complex with near-infrared luminescent response towards metal ions

synthesis.procedure: Under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen using Schlenk techniques, Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.30 mmol, 0.0658 g), NdCl3·6H2O (0.60 mmol, 0.2154 g) and H2L (0.30 mmol, 0.0324 g) were dissolved in 50 mL MeOH at room temperature, and triethylamine in EtOH (1.0 mol/L, 1 mL) was added. The solution was stirred and heated under reflux for 30 min, then filtered. Yellow crystals of 1 formed by slow diffusion of diethyl ether into the filtrate at room temperature over two months. The product was collected and dried at 120 °C for 2 h. The crystalline solid also contains lattice [ZnCl2(H2O)CH3OH]. Yield: 0.0981 g (25%). m.p. > 200 °C (dec.).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature, then reflux; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 30 min reflux; crystallization over two months; drying 2 h at 120 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk reflux in MeOH under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen, then diethyl ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; yellow crystals by slow diffusion of diethyl ether into the filtrate at room temperature over two months; collected and dried in an oven at 120 °C for 2 h. Lattice [ZnCl2(H2O)CH3OH] is present in the crystalline solid.

properties.summary: Ligand-centered excitation sensitizes typical Nd3+ NIR emission. In CH3CN the lifetime is 6.2 μs (consistent with ΦLn = 2.5% using τ0 = 250 μs), Φem = 0.8% and ηsens = 32%; Φem falls to 0.5% in DMF/H2O (1:1). Added metal acetates quench the 1054 nm emission in DMF, most strongly for Li+, Na+ and K+ (ppm-level NIR response); Li+ also lowers ηsens.
